description: Stay in a private house with the full 5 stars service of a palaceThe spaceA Private 5-Star Experience in the Heart of the 16th, Steps from TrocadéroWelcome to a rare address in Paris: a 350 m² private villa exclusively yours, designed as a refined residence blending intimacy, artistry, and five-star service.Your personal butler (available from 8am to 6pm), assisted by a dedicated house manager, ensures a seamless, tailor-made stay with discretion and care. Each morning, enjoy a breakfast prepared to your taste, followed by a sweet or savory afternoon tea. Daily housekeeping maintains the elegance and comfort of your Parisian retreat.An indoor heated pool with counter-current swimming, a wellness space that transforms into a yoga, Pilates, or private cinema room, and a 70 m² rooftop with bioclimatic pergola and summer kitchen invite you to relax, entertain, and savor each moment.On request, the team can arrange a private chef, sommelier, mixologist, chauffeur, personal trainer, beauty treatments, child-friendly experiences, and more — all in the privacy of the house.At a glance:Prestigious villa with exclusive use (5 ensuite bedrooms), located in a calm, residential areaFive-star services included: butler, house manager, daily breakfast, afternoon tea, housekeeping, VIP welcomeTailor-made luxury add-ons: chef, wellness, private driver, children’s activities, entertainmentPrivate wellness amenities: spa, heated pool, rooftop terrace, convertible cinema roomMaison Montespan is not a hotel — it’s your Parisian home, with the excellence of a grand palace.Copyright © Luxury Retreats.
